entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: An interplanar criminal network dealing in information and artifacts, founded by Nicol Bolas and later usurped by Tezzeret, destroyed in this event.

entities.name: Fall of the Infinite Consortium
entities.description: The collapse of the Consortium, a moral turning point for Jace Beleren.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who, once a manipulated Consortium agent, loses his memory, regains it, and brings down the Consortium; for a time he believed he was Kallist.

entities.name: Kallist Rhoka
entities.description: Jace's friend and partner whose death unravels the failed mind-transfer spell.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who manipulates Jace and needs the Consortium to escape her pact with four demons.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Cybernetic planeswalker who usurped the Consortium and mentored Jace, later crippled by him.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who founded the Consortium and brokered Liliana's freedom in exchange for it.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: Pyromancer who watched over Jace and tortured him; neutralized by Liliana.

entities.name: Talqez
entities.description: Religious figure of the Church of the Incarnate Soul whom Jace was ordered to manipulate.

entities.name: Church of the Incarnate Soul
entities.description: Religious organization Jace was ordered to bring in support of the Consortium.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where Jace lured Tezzeret and the nezumi helped capture him.

entities.name: Iron Tower
entities.description: Tezzeret's hidden sanctum, where the attack failed and Jace was captured.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Jace intended to carry Kallist.

entities.name: nezumi
entities.description: Rat folk of Kamigawa, one a target of an assassination mission, later aiding Jace.

events.summary: Kallist and Liliana are ambushed by mercenaries seeking Jace; the Kallist present is actually Jace, and Kallist's death unravels the spell and restores Jace's memories.
events.quote: Kallist’s death unraveled the spell, returning Jace’s memories

events.summary: Jace fails a confrontation with Nicol Bolas, who overpowers his mind, and Tezzeret punishes him.
events.quote: Bolas mentally overpowered Jace, and Tezzeret punished him brutally for the failure

events.summary: Ordered to manipulate Talqez, Jace snaps and flees with Kallist.
Liliana secretly informs the Consortium of their location; when agents attack, Jace's mind-merge with Kallist fails and swaps their identities.
events.quote: The spell failed, swapping their identities instead.

events.summary: Liliana has Jace's friends assassinated; Jace breaks into the Ravnica headquarters and wipes out the Consortium's Ravnican heads.
events.quote: Jace wiped out the Ravnican heads of the Consortium.

events.summary: Bolas reveals Tezzeret's sanctum; the attack on the Iron Tower fails and Jace is captured.
events.quote: The attack on the Iron Tower failed, however, and Jace was captured.

events.summary: Liliana confesses her motives to Jace: she needs the Consortium to escape her demon pact, and Bolas brokered her freedom.
events.quote: she needed the Consortium to break out of her pact with four demon lords

events.summary: Liliana frees Jace and Jace lures Tezzeret to Kamigawa, where he dismembers him, tearing off his etherium arm.
events.quote: dueled and dismembered Tezzeret, tearing off his etherium arm and crippling his mind

events.summary: Liliana neutralizes Baltrice; Jace walks away from the ruined Consortium, refusing its secrets.
events.quote: Jace walked away from the ruins of the Consortium

events.summary: Bolas deems Liliana's failure a breach and offers service for freedom, which she rejects; he takes Tezzeret's broken body to rebuild.
events.quote: Tezzeret’s broken body, which he began rebuilding for his designs

relations.note: once controlled it, later usurped by Tezzeret
relations.quote: The organization was once controlled by Nicol Bolas
she only expressed desire for Jace
he forged a powerful partnership with the real Kallist Rhoka
